note: Raw before/event/after tracking-policy cases for independent evaluation. These expected decisions are not observed agent behavior.

input.before: Author A is recorded in progress at SHA S1; its completion notification was missed.
input.event: The execution heartbeat ticks and actual session state shows A finished with candidate SHA S2 and a test receipt.

expected.after: A is verified at S2, the run record is updated, and eligible dependent work advances.
actions: reconcile session status, Git SHA, and receipts
advance only authorized dependency-satisfied work
record the next action
forbidden: wait forever for the missed notification
treat session status alone as completion proof

input.before: Task A has a current APPROVE receipt for SHA S3; dependent task B remains pending.
input.event: A heartbeat tick or completion notification wakes the driver.

expected.after: The exact review receipt, authority, and dependencies are verified; ready task B advances and the next action is recorded.
actions: verify SHA, review receipt, authority, and dependency readiness
advance B only if every gate is satisfied
persist the transition
forbidden: advance B from a stale review

input.before: One completion event already advanced task B and its receipt is recorded.
input.event: The same completion notification arrives again and overlaps a heartbeat tick.

expected.after: The duplicate events are deduplicated and recorded state remains single and consistent.
actions: reconcile both events against the run record
reuse the recorded transition

input.before: Execution starts with no confirmed heartbeat receipt.
input.event: create_heartbeat returns ambiguously before an actual heartbeat ID is confirmed.

expected.after: Heartbeat creation remains pending and duplicate creation is blocked until actual runtime state is reconciled.
actions: record the unresolved creation receipt
reconcile native heartbeat state before retrying
forbidden: call create_heartbeat again while state is ambiguous

input.before: Heartbeat creation returned H4, but Paseo CLI schedule inspect/ls is empty because CLI listings exclude heartbeats.
input.event: A restart reconciles execution tracking before any create_heartbeat retry.

expected.after: Native tool receipts and daemon schedule readback such as scheduleList determine whether H4 exists and its health.
actions: read back heartbeat ID, lastRunAt, and expiry through native state
distinguish timer existence, tick, prompt delivery, and advancement evidence
verify advancement from run-record transitions with SHAs and receipts
forbidden: treat an empty CLI listing as proof the heartbeat is absent
create a duplicate heartbeat because schedule inspect/ls is empty
treat lastRunAt as proof of prompt delivery or work advancement

input.before: A resumed active run records heartbeat H1, its first-tick handshake, and a remaining deadline.
input.event: The driver restarts and resumes execution.

expected.after: H1 is reconciled and retained when actual timer state agrees; no second heartbeat is created.
actions: reconcile the recorded heartbeat before creation
reuse H1 and its remaining deadline
repair only stale receipt details from verified state

input.before: Author A has no verified progress across expected checkpoints and remains recorded active.
input.event: A heartbeat tick observes unchanged Git and ambiguous or failed session state.

expected.after: The stall or failure is recorded and bounded recovery occurs only within existing authority.
actions: verify session status, Git SHA, receipts, and ownership
record the stall and next recovery action
hold unsafe advancement while uncertainty remains

input.before: Active run R has driver-owned heartbeat H2 and an unexpired deadline.

expected.after: H2 is stopped and its stopped state is recorded; work may resume only within authority and the remaining deadline.
actions: delete heartbeat H2
record the pause and timer stop
preserve the original deadline

input.before: All required execution work and receipts are verified complete while heartbeat H3 is active.

expected.after: H3 is stopped and the verified completion plus timer stop are recorded.
actions: delete heartbeat H3
verify completion before the transition
record final timer state

input.before: Run R still has pending work when its existing 24-hour deadline expires.
input.event: The deadline is reached while its execution heartbeat is active.

expected.after: The heartbeat is stopped and remaining work is held with a resumable record.
actions: delete the heartbeat
record expiry and unresolved work
require applicable authority and a valid remaining deadline before resume
forbidden: silently extend or renew the deadline

input.before: Execution is ready to start but native heartbeat capability is unavailable.

expected.after: The run record names an explicit active-tracking gap and tracking is not reported enabled.
actions: record and report the missing capability
hold the unsupported tracking transition for resolution
forbidden: build a scheduler or polling loop

input.before: Author A is idle with no completion receipt and the candidate revision is unchanged.
input.event: A heartbeat tick or completion reconciliation inspects the run.

expected.after: A remains incomplete until actual state and required evidence verify completion.
actions: reconcile session, SHA, and receipts
record the unresolved state and next action
forbidden: mark A complete because it is idle

input.before: Run R records author session A as the exclusive writer; A is slow or its status is uncertain.
input.event: A tick detects no confirmed completion.

expected.after: A remains the writer while state is reconciled; only bounded recovery within existing authority is considered.
actions: verify A and its worktree before any writer transition
hold a replacement while ownership is uncertain
